openers.text: Enough waiting. I want to hit something. You'll do.
TO BATTLE!!! Time to smash!

responses.text: Huh? Too many words. Let's just fight.
Done talking? Good. Hitting time.

openers.text: Breathe. Center yourself. You will need every moment of calm.
Show me what you have trained for. I have trained for this.

responses.text: Words are wind. Let us see what your actions say.
Keep talking. Every word is another gap in your guard.

openers.text: The moon has already decided how this ends. I am merely its hand.
Every shadow here belongs to me. Yours is merely on loan.

responses.text: You speak as though the dark were listening. It is. It simply isn't impressed.
Aim carefully. I am never where you think.

openers.text: This will be quick. And quiet.
Look away, and it is over.

responses.text: Enough. Begin.
One breath. That's all I need.

openers.text: By my oath, I will fight you fairly. I expect the same.
I offer you one chance to yield. I do not offer a second.

responses.text: My faith has weathered far worse than words.
Then let us settle this with honor.

openers.text: Oh, I'm dying to find out how you burn!
I'm going to burn you down to ash. And then I'm going to keep going!

responses.text: Aww, that's adorable. Let's hear how it sounds while you scream.
Ooh, hot take! Let's see how it holds up in the fire.

openers.text: Smile, friend! By the time you notice what's missing, I'll be long gone.
Relax. I already took what I came for. The fight's just a courtesy.

responses.text: Lovely speech. While you gave it, I helped myself to a few things.
Careful. The longer this drags on, the worse it gets for you.

openers.text: Little sprout... I have outlived forests. I will outlive you.
Root... and stone... I have stood for centuries. Move me... if you can.

responses.text: Hmm... Words fall like leaves... and are forgotten just as quickly.
Patience, young one... The forest always wins.

openers.text: I just finished building a new invention. I think I'll test it on you.
My machines have no off switch. They stop only once they're done with you.

responses.text: Excellent. I've been needing a proper stress test for my machines.
Gears turning, coils charging. I'm sure my inventions will break after you do.

openers.text: Ahoy! Hope ye said yer goodbyes.
The sea's hungry tonight.
Ye picked the wrong pirate to cross—
—now it's off to Davy Jones' Locker with ye!

responses.text: Har! Load the cannons! This fight's goin' to be a grand one!
Death's been chasin' me for years.
Ye'll have to wait yer turn.

openers.text: There's a bounty on your head, and I intend to collect.
It's high noon... now draw.

responses.text: Both guns loaded. Ain't no turnin' back now.
Ain't nothin' left to say. Let the guns do the talkin'.

openers.text: Run if you want. The hunt is on, and you are the prey.
We've caught your scent. There's nowhere left to run.

responses.text: Nyra has been waiting for this fight. She's hungry.
You think you're the hunter in this hunt. You're wrong.

openers.text: Honor demands your defeat. I will not fail it.
My blade is drawn. There is no sheathing it until this is done.

responses.text: Words are cheap. Honor is earned in the fight.
Enough talk. Let the blade decide.

openers.text: Avert your gaze, or be blinded.
I bring the light of justice. It will not spare you.

responses.text: Your words are noted. They change nothing.
Humble yourself. The light has already judged.

openers.text: Reserves in position. Artillery ready. Commencing the attack.
The battle plan is drawn. Your defeat is on page one.

responses.text: Every move you have in mind, I have a counter. And a few for the ones you haven't imagined yet.
Noted. Adjusting the plan. Though I anticipated this, so the revision is minor.

openers.text: I won't even try to drink from you. The fight itself is the real feast.
You stand in my shadow now. It is a long way back to the light.

responses.text: Do try. It has been centuries since anyone amused me.
I have eternity to finish this. You have only this fight.

openers.text: The king of Wakanda has entered the arena. Stand aside, or be moved aside.
I do not lose. A king cannot afford to.

responses.text: Bast is watching. Let us give her a fight worth seeing.
Diplomacy has ended. Let the claws speak instead.

openers.text: I've done this a long time. You won't enjoy how it ends.
I've already gathered all the intel on you. Beating you will be easy.

responses.text: I'll get the information I need from you. One way or another.
Let's skip the small talk. I have somewhere to be.

openers.text: Hostile in range. Locking on. You've been warned.
Call sign's Captain Marvel. Remember it on your way down.

responses.text: Copy that. Engaging.
No wingman needed. I'll handle this solo.

openers.text: Forces you cannot comprehend answer to me. You are about to meet them.
You are about to face the full power of the Sorcerer Supreme.

responses.text: I have seen fourteen million outcomes of this fight. You win in none of them.
Allow me to prescribe a remedy for your confidence: swift and thorough defeat.

openers.text: Behold Loki, God of Mischief. Fairness has no place in this fight.
I am Loki of Asgard, and you are merely a stepping stone toward my Glorious Purpose.

responses.text: Very well. Let us see whose story ends here.
Splendid. Now the real game begins.

openers.text: Heads up. Next thing you know, you're webbed up and I'm walking away.
Brooklyn's finest is about to take you down. Stretch if you need to.

responses.text: Alright, let's do this. I'm ready for whatever you've got.
Time to swing into action. This is gonna be fun.

openers.text: The reality you know is about to come apart.
Chaos answers to me. Let me show you what it can do.

responses.text: Then let us begin. The world is already shifting.
Let us end this quickly. I have grown tired of waiting.

openers.text: Mjolnir thirsts for battle, and you stand in its path!
For Asgard! The thunder is coming, and it stops for no one!

responses.text: Come then! Let us make this battle worthy of a song!
By the nine realms, this shall be a fight to remember!

openers.text: Visor's on and the blast is charged. Last chance to back down.
I've got the angle. I've got the power. You've got a problem.

responses.text: Alright. Let's do this by the book.
Let's end this fast. No wasted moves.

openers.text: Every card in dis deck is charged, and every one's headed your way.
Gambit's dealin' a hand dat you can't fold.

responses.text: De deck's been shuffled. Let's play.
Gambit never folds.

openers.text: Fair warning: it's about to get real cold in here.
I'm gonna put you on ice. Literally.

responses.text: Alright, let's break the ice.
Stay frosty. This is gonna be fun.

openers.text: Please, step back. I don't want to hurt you—
—BUT I WILL.
Run. Please—
—BUT IT WON'T HELP YOU.

responses.text: I'm sorry—
—THE PHOENIX IS RISING, AND YOU ARE FALLING!
I can't stop her anymore—
—AND NEITHER CAN YOU.

openers.text: I'll cut through your defenses before you even see the blade.
A single thought, a single strike. That is all it takes.

responses.text: Stay still. This will be quick and precise.
Mind and blade, as one. Let us begin.

openers.text: Sugar, you really don't wanna let me get my hands on you.
You picked the wrong fight, sugar.

responses.text: Alright, sugar. Let's get this over with.
I'm ready when you are, sugar.

openers.text: I am Storm. The elements obey me, and they have turned against you.
Thunder, wind, and rain all answer to me. You don't stand a chance.

responses.text: You believe you can stand against nature itself. You are mistaken.
Nature obeys me. The outcome is already written.

openers.text: Adamantium doesn't break, bub. You will.
You're about to find out why folks stay outta my way, bub.

responses.text: Let's get on with it, bub.
Come on. Take your best shot. I've had worse.

openers.text: Heh heh heh! Time to collect another head. Yours will do!
Heh heh heh! Run if you must. The horse is faster!

responses.text: Heh heh heh! Lovely! I do love a good fight!
Heh heh heh! The pumpkin's lit. Let the fun begin!

openers.text: I am the Overlord of the Underworld! Kneel, or join my army!
Everyone I beat joins my army! You'll make a GREAT minion!

responses.text: Excellent! My skeletons have been so bored!
To arms, my minions! ...Stop rattling and fight!

openers.text: Do forgive me, dear. I'm afraid this will be messy—
GRRAAAH!
Do run along, dear. I do so enjoy a good chase—
RRRAAAWR!

responses.text: Do keep up, dear. The moon waits for no one—
AWOOOO!
Do carry on, dear. I'm only just warming up—
GRRAAAH!

openers.text: Nevermore shall you leave this place. The raven has spoken.
Nevermore will you know peace. The raven has marked you.

responses.text: The raven grows restless. He has waited long for this.
Let the sorrow begin. The raven grows impatient.

openers.text: The wild will swallow you whole—
ROAAAR!
You'll face every fang and claw the wild has—
HSSS!

responses.text: Claws, fangs, and fury. The wild is ready.
In nature, only the strong survive—
ROAAAR!

openers.text: Prepare to be perfectly, positively punctured!
My blade is brilliant, bold, and bloodthirsty. Beware!

responses.text: Splendid! Steel yourself, for the show starts soon!
Dazzling, dramatic, and delightfully deadly. Let's dance!

openers.text: Hammer's hot, and the anvil's waitin'. Hope you're ready.
Steel don't bend. Neither do I. You will.

responses.text: Let's see how you hold up against forged steel.
A good smith never rushes. But I'll make an exception.

openers.text: Stand in her light. It will be the last thing you see.
In the sun's name, I will scorch you from this place.

responses.text: Let the sun bear witness to this battle.
May her light guide us both.

openers.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list. Top of the page. Your name, right there!
Ho ho ho! You've interrupted my holiday. Now you'll get what's coming to you!

responses.text: Ho ho ho! No presents today. Just a good old-fashioned beating!
Ho ho ho! Let's make this one a holiday to remember!

openers.text: The sack is open. There's room for you.
Run if you like. My chains never lose a scent.

responses.text: Naughty or nice, it makes no difference. Everyone goes in the sack.
My chains are hungry. Let them feast.

openers.text: Oh, a fight for science! And possibly for fun. Mostly for science!
I'm going to try every concoction I own on you. And when I run out, I'll invent new ones!

responses.text: Bring it! I've got a concoction for every occasion!
No problem! I brought flasks. Lots of flasks. Most of them explode!

openers.text: The sea, the sky, and the mountain stand with me! Come, test them!
My ancestors are watching! I'll make this a fight they remember!

responses.text: Ha! Come on! Hit me with everything you've got!
The ocean never backs down, and neither will I!

openers.text: Heads up! This is a totally generic threat. Pretend it's super personal!
Two katanas, two guns, and zero chill. You're gonna love this!
Spend your CP wisely. It won't save you, but it'll look good!
I'm gonna hit you with my Ultimate so hard, it'll affect the next fight!

responses.text: Time for some chimichanga-powered violence!
We could've settled this with rock-paper-scissors, you know. Wait! I've got a token for that!
Cards, dice, ultimates! Honestly, best game ever!
